Subject: SCIM delta + JIT admin examples for SOC2/SIG review

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. For the SOC2/SIG intake we need a scoped SCIM delta showing provisioning/deprovisioning events for the last two weeks (starting Apr 25). In addition we need a justification package for any just-in-time / ephemeral admin elevations that occurred during that window — specifically for the two service accounts listed below. The auditor team wants: who approved the elevation, exact start/end timestamps, and the linked change request or ticket.

Service accounts of interest: svc-deploy@navahealth.com, svc-migrations@navahealth.com

Also please include an RBAC owner matrix that maps roles to owning teams (email + title) and note any roles that were modified in the last 90 days. If you can deliver CSVs for the deltas and an annotated PDF for the JIT narrative, that will speed our review.

Let me know if you need a template — otherwise a simple CSV + PDF is fine.

Cheers,
John Miller
Senior IT Auditor
NavaHealth Audit Team

Thanks Irene — this looks like the right shape. A couple clarifications before we accept the CSV as evidence for SIG:

1) For each flagged JIT elevation please include: approver (name + email), approval timestamp, and the ticket/CR link (Jira or internal change id).
2) For the two service accounts (svc-deploy and svc-migrations) we need a short narrative per elevation explaining why the account needed elevated rights and confirmation that privileges were scoped back (if applicable).

Example entry we expect in the PDF:

If you can annotate the CSV with approval fields or deliver a small PDF mapping flags to approvals, that will be enough.

Thanks,
John
